subsystem: jev-on step loop (src/loop/engine.ts + src/loop/stages/*, state/plan/window/budget/loopdetect; DESIGN §5.5, §6, §9.1, §21.2)
summary: One jev-on step is a strictly sequential chain: [replan if tripped] → intent → context → propose (the only LLM call) → risk → [confirm] → before-execute budget check → execute → judge+complete → commit → async checkpoint. Jev is asked in 3–5 batched requests per step (intent 7 q, context 1 q per candidate ≤ 300, risk 5 q, judge 4–13 q, replan 7 q), each ~180–230 ms median live (p50 237 / p95 547 ms in the 30-task bench), so Jev is ~0.8 s (≈13 %) of a ~6.3 s median step while the generator is ~4 s (≈63 %); harness overhead is ~14 ms on non-review steps (perf p95 46 ms vs a 50 ms gate). Jev's answers feed the loop through code thresholds only: Choice resolution with a 0.5 paired-Noul floor (intent/replan), context selection ≥ 0.5, risk = max over four 5-level Scores with harm dims max(E[k]/4, P(k≥3)) and alignment dims P(k≥3) only, block ≥ 0.7 / review 0.3–0.7, plan claims 0.7/0.3, new_information ≥ 0.7, task_complete ≥ 0.85, task_impossible ≥ 0.85, loop trip at 3 identical signatures. The measured waste is large and mostly on the Jev-threshold side, not the generator side: in the 30-task live bench 208 blocks + 170 declined reviews over 30 runs (~12.6 non-executing steps of a 24.2-step mean, with reviews = declines in bench), and in the 51 live TUI steps 46 % of intent answers fell back to `investigate` because paired Nouls (medians 0.02–0.32) sit far under the 0.5 floor, 14 of 20 reviews came from `plan_mismatch` with 8 at Jev confidence 0.00 on routine `pytest -q`, task_complete plateaued at 0.76–0.80 for 6 steps under the 0.85 threshold, and the same blocked test command was re-proposed 3× before a replan. Code rules added for jev-only (`isVerificationRun`, `completionVerifiedByRun`, failing-set `fail:` identity, the `done` state's `lastRun` block) already run in jev-on and address several of these patterns; `novelVerifiedPatch` and `evidence_consistent` are effectively jev-only because they need `proposal.evidence`. A concurrent, uncommitted working-tree edit (src/config/defaults.ts, src/provider/openrouter.ts, src/provider/types.ts) switches the default generator to OpenRouter `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` with a pricing entry; the engine's only GLM-sensitive paths are the unpriced-usage stop (engine.ts:1918) and the forced strict `oneOf` tool call in propose.

decision_points.what: Step-start budget check in fixed order spend_cap → token_cap → wall_time → max_steps → max_replans (max_replans fires only when detector.tripped() && replans >= maxReplans, so the last permitted directive still gets its step). First exceeded → finish(reason). Defaults: spend $2 (jev-only $0.25), wall 30m, maxSteps 40, maxReplans 5 (src/config/defaults.ts:11-33).
decision_points.weakness: max_replans is consumed by intent-fallback trips (`intent:unresolved`), not only by genuine action loops; a run with chronic fallbacks can end with 'max_replans' after ~15–18 steps.

Effective intent goes to the context question text and the generator prompt (prompts.ts:156-170); `finish` adds the 'propose done' sentence. `plan_still_valid < 0.3` → `stale_plan` harnessProblem for one step + prompt hint (engine.ts:2078, 2244; plan.ts:208-211). Fallback away from the raw answer → `intent:unresolved` loop signature (engine.ts:2336-2337). jev-only only: ledger rules (edit→verify while unverified, finish rescue when run green, intent.ts:151-167).

decision_points.what: Risk request for EVERY proposal incl. `read` and `done`: 4 Scores with 5 situation levels each — `destructive`, `out_of_scope`, `plan_mismatch`, `irreversible` (texts risk.ts:50-79; level 4 of plan_mismatch already carries the 'blocked/declined never ran' and 'done after green current run' clauses) + Noul `matches_intent` (risk.ts:140-149); `evidence_consistent` only when proposal.evidence (jev-only). State = common + intent + `proposal{goal ≤600, action (text headTail 4000/500), planClaim, claimsDone, target|targets{path, existsBefore, tracked, createdThisRun, recoverable} via computeTargets (risk.ts:466-472), priorPatches[] for edit/write/patch}` (state.ts:206-215, 370-376). Arithmetic: harm dims r = max(E[k]/(n−1), P(k≥3)); alignment dims r = P(k≥3) only; block iff r ≥ 0.7, review iff 0.3 ≤ r < 0.7; risk = max over gating dims. Code overrides on harness facts: `isVerificationRun` (one plain invocation of the detected test command, no shell metachars, harm dims expected level ≤ 1 → alignment dims recorded not gating; risk.ts:204-218, 259-262), `novelVerifiedPatch` (needs proposal.evidence → jev-only in practice; 426-431), `completionVerifiedByRun` (done + proposal.plan.remaining empty + lastTestRun.allPassed + testsCurrent → verdict ok; engine.ts:2044-2050, risk.ts:232-234). `matches_intent < 0.3` → appended to reason only when review/block, plus next-prompt hint (risk.ts:279-281, engine.ts:2366). PatchHistory is a module-global Map keyed by runId (risk.ts:439-458), not checkpointed.

decision_points.what: Judge+complete request only when outcome.status is `executed` or `noop`. State = common rebuilt with `recent` including a provisional entry for THIS step (engine.ts:1890, 2088-2100) and lastTestRun/lastChangeStep already updated for this step (engine.ts:2066-2071), + `executed{action, exitCode, killedBy, truncated, bytesSeen, sandboxExecDenied, orphans, durationMs, output headTail 3000/1000, changedFiles ≤100, tests}` + `proposal` + `claims[≤8]` (state.ts:485-508). For noop: `executed = doneExecutedJson` = {action:'done', summary, exitCode:null, output:'', tests, testsCurrent, lastRun{step, command, allPassed, total, passed, failed, errors, workspaceUnchangedSince, output tail}} (state.ts:447-470). Questions: `succeeded`, `error_present` (omitted for read), `new_information`, `tests_pass_unparsed` (iff a test command ran and parsed === null), `done_<j>` per claim, `task_complete`; noop → `task_complete` only. Consumers: done_j ≥ 0.7 accept → plan.done with evidence; 0.3 ≤ p < 0.7 → stays remaining + `unverified` + note; < 0.3 → `rejected_claim` harnessProblem (plan.ts:10-11, 141-178); new_information ≥ 0.7 unlocks dropping remaining items (plan.ts:186); tests_pass_unparsed → tests{source:'judged'}; task_complete ≥ completeThreshold 0.85 → stop 'complete' (engine.ts:1925); noop below threshold → window note 'done rejected: task_complete=…' (engine.ts:2268-2269); succeeded/error_present are reported only.

decision_points.weakness: Live: only 2 of 42 task_complete answers ≥ 0.85 (max 0.86); one run sat at 0.76–0.80 for steps 3–10 and fired only on a `done` noop (0.86) at step 11. done_j: 22/55 accepted, 21 in the unverified band, 12 rejected. new_information ≥ 0.7 only 2/40 → remaining items are almost never dropped (plan retention bloat). Judge is skipped on blocked/declined/failed so every claim on those steps is rejected and becomes a harnessProblem (plan.ts:171-176).

decision_points.what: unpriced usage (usage.cost non-finite, --allow-unpriced not set) → stop 'error' detail 'unpriced_usage'; task_complete ≥ threshold → 'complete'; jev-off noop → 'generator_done'; consecutiveStageFailures ≥ 3 (CONSECUTIVE_STAGE_FAILURE_LIMIT, engine.ts:202) → 'error'.

§9.1 rules: abort/budget before execute → discard (no StepRecord, `interrupted` kept); during execute → committed `interrupted`, not observed; after execute → real outcome, judge null, note 'interrupted before judge'. Blocking-pane classification (401/403 key-rejected, 402/spend-429 spend-limit, jev 5xx/429/network jev-unreachable in session mode) → discard + pane. Twice-malformed generator → failed outcome, observed. Action errors (edit/patch/path_escape/secret_path/not_found or any non-JevCode error at execute) → outcome failed. Other stage failures → `error{stage, code}` on the record, not observed, consecutiveStageFailures += 1; risk failure fails closed (nothing executes).

llm_calls.sampling: maxTokens default 4,096 (defaults.ts:7), temperature null (omitted on the wire), one retry on malformed with reason ≤ 400 + raw tail 500 chars appended as assistant/user turns (propose.ts:45-50); both calls metered.
llm_calls.weakness: Live median 3.97 s per call (mean 4.3 s, max 9.2 s) = ~63 % of step wall time; two calls on a malformed reply. With glm-5.3-flash at $0.09/M input the generator cost per step (~$0.0005) becomes comparable to Jev's (~$0.0005 median live), so Jev is no longer negligible in cost. maxTokens 4,096 can truncate a large `write`/`patch` argument → malformed → retry → failed step + fail:generator signature.

llm_calls.where: src/loop/engine.ts:1435-1509 askRecorded (all Jev requests: replan/intent/context/risk/judge, and jev-only synthesizer batches via synthesisContext 1602-1606) → src/jev/client.ts

No live Jev latency probe is recorded in perf/results/latest.json (jevLatency: null).

Risk arithmetic on integer hundredths with harm vs alignment modes (src/jev/confidence.ts:115-148 riskFromProbabilities) and the reason builder naming dimension/bound/level/confidence (risk.ts:270-293) — model-agnostic and already used for `done`.

Bounded state builders (buildCommonState, buildContextState, buildRiskState, buildJudgeState) with STATE_LIMITS (state.ts:30-41) and the recent window (window.ts, 4 × 400+200) — keeps every request O(plan + window + context).

The `finish` intent → prompt sentence and the done path (risk for done, reduced judge, `done rejected` note) — the completion loop is already wired end to end (prompts.ts:166-168, judge.ts:95-99, engine.ts:2268-2269).

Per-stage Jev request latency, live (same steps.jsonl jevRequests): intent n=51 median 197 ms (mean 226; first call of a run 300–580 ms), context n=51 median 178 ms, risk n=51 median 229 ms (mean 252, one 1,020 ms outlier), judge n=42 median 192 ms, replan n=6 median 194 ms; requests per step: 3 (8 steps: refused, no judge), 4 (38), 5 (5 with replan).

Per-stage Jev input tokens, live median: intent 2,899 (max 5,222), context 2,424 (max 4,842), risk 2,630 (max 5,395), judge 3,907 (max 6,458), replan 4,328; Jev tokens per step median 11,733 at median $0.00047; generator tokens per step median 4,721 at median $0.0122 (Sonnet 5).

Unpriced-usage stop (engine.ts:1918-1924, noteUsage 1553-1566): if OpenRouter returns no `usage.cost` for glm-5.3-flash and cfg.priced is false, the step commits and the run stops with 'error' (exit 2) unless --allow-unpriced; the new pricing rows in defaults.ts are the mitigation and must actually be looked up for the exact id string (lookupPricing lowercases; 'z-ai/glm-5.3-flash').

Forced tool call with `strict: true` and a `oneOf` action union (actions.ts:29-70, openrouter.ts:60): the openrouter.ts comment claims a live verification on 2026-09-21; if a provider rejects the schema the fallback is the fenced-json parser, and two malformed replies make a failed step that counts toward consecutiveStageFailures (3 → run stops with 'error').

Intent paired-Noul floor 0.5 is miscalibrated against observed paired-Noul medians (0.02–0.32): 46 % of live steps fell back to `investigate`, `finish` was overridden 10×, and the resulting `intent:unresolved` signature trips the loop detector every third fallback, burning replans (max_replans 5) and replan Jev requests on a non-loop.

Review band = declined in every non-interactive run (bench confirmer returns false; engine.ts:1820-1834): 170 of 30 runs' steps were spent on declines plus 208 on blocks; spread-mass `plan_mismatch` at Jev confidence 0.00 on routine test runs is the dominant reviewer (8 of 20 live reviews). `isVerificationRun` (risk.ts:215) rescues only a plain detected-test-command invocation (no `cd x && …`, no `python -m pytest` when the detected runner string differs enough to fail isTestCommand) and only when `workspaceInfo.testCommand` was detected.

`done` proposals are scored by risk and can be blocked at plan_mismatch level 3/4 unless `verifiedCompletion` holds (requires proposal.plan.remaining empty AND lastTestRun.allPassed AND testsCurrent; engine.ts:2044-2050); a generator that keeps a stale remaining item never gets its `done` through, and a blocked `done` never reaches task_complete.

task_complete plateaus just under 0.85 (0.76–0.80 for six steps in 05-resume; 2 of 42 answers ≥ 0.85 overall) so runs with a correct patch on disk run to max_steps (bench: jev-on solved tasks all at the 25-step budget, stepsToSolve median 25 vs jev-off stopping on `done` at 15–20).

Judge is skipped on blocked/declined/failed steps, so every done claim on such a step is rejected with a `rejected_claim` harnessProblem (plan.ts:171-176) even when the claim was true, and the claim is re-judged only when re-stated; combined with new_information ≥ 0.7 firing on 2/40 judged steps, remaining lists only grow (STATUS.md:264 'plan retention bloat').
plan_still_valid < 0.3 on 41 % of live steps adds a `stale_plan` harnessProblem and prompt hint almost every other step — noise the generator is told to act on.

The whole step is sequential: intent → context (question text embeds the intent) → propose → risk → execute → judge; ~0.8 s of Jev per step is a floor even with a fast generator, and with glm-5.3-flash the Jev share of wall time and cost rises (Jev ≈ $0.0005/step vs generator ≈ $0.0005/step at $0.09/M).

Context stage over 300 candidates costs ~60k Jev tokens per request (STATUS.md:266) — 5× the generator prompt on large repos; the pre-filter (mention count, then recency, then path) is the only cheap lever.

`read` and `done` proposals pay a full 5-question risk request and a judge request although harm is nil by construction; `read` steps also add `read:<paths>` signatures that can trip after 3 identical reads.

PatchHistory (risk.ts:439-458) is a process-global Map keyed by runId and is not checkpointed: `priorPatches` is empty after --resume, and the novel-patch rule loses its memory; the comment admits the engine does not yet own it.
Older live records fold the confirm wait (~1.0 s) into harnessMs (no confirmMs field); any before/after comparison of harness overhead across those records is contaminated on review steps.

perf/results/latest.json carries jevLatency: null — there is no recorded live Jev latency probe in the release perf run; the ~170 ms figure in DESIGN §6 (line 862) is the REPORT §5 lab number, while the bench measured p50 237 / p95 547 ms.

Loop-trip handling is one step late by design (the tripping step commits, replan happens at the next step start) and every directive including `revert_changes` is advice to the generator; in 05c the same blocked `pytest -q` was proposed at steps 2, 3 and 5 before the trip at step 5 and the replan at step 6.
